caption: Imagine if Diwali never ended. Day 1 is perfect: diyas, rangoli, new clothes and endless mithai. By day 30, even the kaju katli has had enough of you. Firecrackers every single night would be a real problem, because Diwali fireworks already cause a sharp spike in air pollution in many Indian cities. Keeping the lights on all year would send electricity bills through the roof. And the ones who'd suffer most are our pets: loud fireworks frighten many dogs and cats, and they can't tell us how stressful it is. One Diwali a year is just right. This year it's on 8 November. Would YOU survive 365 days of Diwali? 👇
